files.what: Exact wording of the trustee area and 1 February 2022 redistricting section of the governing board page, with its two links. No resolution or report is linked.
Live governing board page (same map links and redistricting text as the saved copy inventory/news/district-boards-2026-10-04/saugus-board.html).
Static map "Saugus Union School District Governing Board Trustee Areas, Approved Trustee Areas, May 2022". Esri ArcMap 10.8.1 export, created 17 May 2022. Image/PDF only, no extractable geometry.

KML export of the Google My Maps map linked as "Interactive" (https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/0/edit?mid=1BizBoI6gCjAlAKh1h9b_GoSz5_jH-6Jv&usp=sharing). Document "Saugus Union School District / Governing Board Trustee Areas". 6 polygons: district outline plus "Trustee Area No. 1" to "No. 5" (area number in the Placemark name). KML, WGS84 lon/lat. Rings closed; the five areas sum to the district outline within 0.1 percent.
